I'm a Master of Science in Business Analytics student at Baruch College's Zicklin School of Business, concentrating in Data Analytics, with an expected graduation in 2027. I'm building toward a career in **healthcare analytics**, using data to improve how care is delivered and managed.

My path here runs through finance and technology. I earned a BBA in Finance from Brooklyn College, spent two years at an accounting firm, and then moved into tech and data handling at a city hospital. Since then, I've interned at **IBM** as a Systems Administrator and at **Ericsson** in Finance Data Science & Automation. I also hold CompTIA A+ and Network+ certifications.

Outside of work and school, I'm a **purple belt in Brazilian jiu-jitsu** and run a free monthly training session for seniors. I also used to travel across New York State to compete in video game tournaments.

**Skills:** R, Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), SQL, Excel, Power BI, Git/GitHub, Quarto

This site will host my STA 9750 projects as I build out my data science portfolio.
